messages.subject: Conference: R in Insurance 11 July 2016
parts:
I am organising together with Andreas Tsanakas from Cass Business School London the 4th R in Insurance conference on 11 July 2016.

It would be great to have talks that showcase Stan in the context of insurance as well.

Please submit your abstract by the end of March. For more details visit: http://www.rininsurance.com

Thanks

—
Markus Gesmann
